clauses.clause: Perform a thorough, fresh-eyes re-evaluation of /srv/dev/ras/masterplan after its extensive modifications.
Identify legacy, dead, and incorrect elements during the re-evaluation.
Seed a remediation bundle for the findings that are confirmed.
Use parallel deepseek-v4-flash workflows for bulk investigation.
Run the bulk-investigation workflows on the user's own hardware with no token cost.
Every finding must include a path-and-line citation.
Every finding must include direct evidence.
Do not infer findings from names alone.
